subject: cult-info-fo
title: (R)CULT.INFO.B.------T.C.IMP.
description: Chart 1 of 3 on book p. 77 (WAM-19). CULT-INFO-FO (the title writes CULT.INFO.B.) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) is the partner. From the subject: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and INFO-CON (information convergence), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". From INFO-CON: RE-ST (restructuralism). CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis) is on a dotted line from INFO-CON. From RE-ST: ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics) and AF-TF. From ACC-DY: MT-INFO (multi-information). From AF-TF: CULT-TF-S, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of".
